summary: Find tracks similar to a given track.
description: Returns a list of tracks that are similar to the specified track ID. Similarity is based primarily on tags (genre, instrument, mood, etc.), acoustic/electric characteristics, vocal/instrumental balance, and additional metadata such as artists, language, and gender. Results are sorted by a relevance score (0‑1). The call requires a client_id API key and the track id. Optional parameters let you exclude the original artist or album, control pagination, choose result format, include extra fields, and select audio/audio‑download formats. Note that the 'fullcount' flag can impact performance and 'limit' is capped at 200 rows even when using 'all'.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the track which the returned similar tracks must be similar to.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200. The keyword 'all' still caps at 200 rows.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, adds 'results_fullcount' to the header indicating the total number of rows without limit/offset. May affect performance.

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.description: Cover image size in pixels. If omitted, a default size is returned.

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Audio format for the 'audio' field. Defaults to mp31 if not specified.

parameters.name: audiodlformat
parameters.description: Audio download format for the 'audiodownload' field. Defaults to the value of 'audioformat' or mp32 if neither is set.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma‑separated list of additional fields to append to the results.

parameters.name: no_artist
parameters.description: Artist ID to exclude from the results.

parameters.name: no_album
parameters.description: Album ID to exclude from the results.

notes: The 'callback' parameter is ignored for non‑JSON formats or non‑GET requests.
'fullcount' is not available on some heavy methods due to performance considerations.
Even when 'limit=all' is used, the maximum number of returned rows is capped at 200.
